Job Details: 
 
 
 Job Description: 
 The Role and Impact 
 
As a Manufacturing Systems Software Development Engineer, you will play a pivotal role in designing, developing, and sustaining software solutions critical to Intel's manufacturing ecosystem.
 You'll have the opportunity to work across the entire software stack, from cloud and container platforms to applications, middleware, firmware, and embedded systems. In this role, you'll help deliver the technologies that enable factory operations and advance Intel's manufacturing capabilities.
 Your contributions will directly enhance operational efficiency, product quality, and scalability, ensuring Intel remains at the forefront of technology manufacturing.
 This position offers a unique opportunity to engage with cutting-edge technologies, collaborate with cross-functional teams, and make a tangible impact on Intel's success.

 Key Responsibilities 
 Design, develop, debug, and optimize software for factory automation, wafer processing, and packaging systems.
 Collaborate with cross-functional engineering teams to integrate hardware, software, and systems into seamless manufacturing workflows.
 Develop automated solutions to improve process monitoring, data collection, and real-time analysis in mission-critical environments.
 Create and validate software test plans, ensuring compliance with quality and performance standards.
 Diagnose and resolve complex software and hardware issues across multiple technical domains.
 Implement software engineering process improvements to enhance scalability, reliability, and efficiency in production.
 Support new manufacturing product introductions by developing and deploying robust software solutions tailored to factory requirements.
 Provide technical support to manufacturing teams, enabling rapid resolution of production challenges.
 
 
 Qualifications: 
 Minimum Qualifications
 Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, Software Engineering, or a related field with 4+ years of relevant experience; Master's degree with 3+ years of relevant experience; or PhD with 1+ years of relevant experience.
 Hands-on experience working with one or more programming languages and applications.
 Strong experience with the full Software Development Lifecycle (SDLC), including requirements gathering, design, implementation, testing, debugging, validation, deployment, and maintenance.
 Familiarity with networking protocols, operating system configurations, and secure code development.
 Technical expertise in scripting and automation for manufacturing environments.
 .

Preferred Qualifications
 Experience with manufacturing systems, automated material handling, or distributed enterprise applications.
 Proficiency in lab equipment usage and data analysis for process optimization.
 Knowledge of high-speed testing, mixed-signal systems, or thermal subsystem components.
 Strong problem-solving, analytical, and troubleshooting skills.
 Excellent communication and collaboration skills, with a customer-focused mindset.
 Familiarity with Intel's manufacturing processes or test engineering technologies is a plus.
 

We are looking for passionate engineers ready to innovate and shape the future of manufacturing technology. Join us and drive meaningful change while advancing your career in a dynamic, fast-paced environment.
 
           
 
 
 Job Type:
Experienced Hire 
 
 Shift:
Shift 1 (United States of America) 
 
 Primary Location: 
US, Oregon, Hillsboro 
 
 Additional Locations:
 
 
 
 
 Posting Statement:
All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, religious creed, sex, national origin, ancestry, age, physical or mental disability, medical condition, genetic information, military and veteran status, marital status, pregnancy, gender, gender expression, gender identity, sexual orientation, or any other characteristic protected by local law, regulation, or ordinance. 
 Position of Trust
N/A 
 Benefits
 
 We offer a total compensation package that ranks among the best in the industry. It consists of competitive pay, stock bonuses, and benefit programs which include health, retirement, and vacation. Find out more about the benefits of working at Intel . 
  
  
Annual Salary Range for jobs which could be performed in the US: $128,880.00-181,940.00 USD  
  
The range displayed on this job posting reflects the minimum and maximum target compensation for the position across all US locations. Within the range, individual pay is determined by work location and additional factors, including job-related skills, experience, and relevant education or training. Your recruiter can share more about the specific compensation range for your preferred location during the hiring process.  
  
 
 Work Model for this Role 
This role will require an on-site presence. * Job posting details (such as work model, location or time type) are subject to change. 
 *
 
ADDITIONAL INFORMATION: Intel is committed to Responsible Business Alliance (RBA) compliance and ethical hiring practices. We do not charge any fees during our hiring process. Candidates should never be required to pay recruitment fees, medical examination fees, or any other charges as a condition of employment. If you are asked to pay any fees during our hiring process, please report this immediately to your recruiter.
